name: Apply Trim Finish (Brush Method)
intent: Brush finish coat onto primed trim. One coat per module invocation. Scenarios needing two coats list this module twice with interstage between. Brush is the slow, careful method — preserves brush marks that are part of the desired finish look on residential trim.
doctrine: Coat 1 (80 LF/hr) is slower than coat 2 (90 LF/hr) because the painter is working over primer with no color reference, lapping carefully. Coat 2 has the wet-in-wet advantage of an existing color line to follow. Both rates are slower than spray (380-445 LF/hr) by ~5x — brush trim is the slowest method in residential work.
